top_signals.title: Lower Multiples Will Bring PE Back: Kindler
top_signals.summary: Robert Kindler, global chair of the M&A group at Paul, Weiss, Rifkind, Wharton & Garrison, joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." They discussed the record pace for M&A and his outlook for 2027.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
